description: Pure finite-data test of whether a complex/density-matrix representation is forced by F01 plus witnessed weak noncommutation, or whether a strictly weaker representation reproduces the same probe quotient and update evidence.
kernel_definition: x ~_P y iff p(x) == p(y) for every p in P; identity in this finite fixture is the class of x in S/~_P.

F01.name: finitude
F01.condition: S is finite and P is finite

N01.name: weak_noncommutation
N01.condition: there exists x in S with U1(U2(x)) != U2(U1(x))

commuting_update_control.description: N01-absent control: V1 and V2 commute everywhere on S.

probe_erase_control.description: Remove p_alpha and recompute the quotient from the remaining probes.

label_shuffle_control.description: Deterministic relabelling of probe outcomes that preserves equality blocks.

candidate_structures.name: bare_set_quotient
candidate_structures.description: The partition S/~_P with one finite label per class and the induced probe-outcome labelling; no additive, convex, linear, or matrix structure.

candidate_structures.name: classical_probability_simplex
candidate_structures.description: Probability distributions over the quotient classes with real-valued probe functions; update operations are restricted to a commuting diagonal family for this fixture.

candidate_structures.name: real_vector_real_operator
candidate_structures.description: Real vector states/effects over quotient-class basis states; update maps are represented by real deterministic transition matrices.

candidate_structures.name: complex_operator_density_matrix
candidate_structures.description: Complex positive trace-one matrix states and Hermitian effects; this candidate is tested only after the pure finite quotient and update data are measured.

candidate_structures.name: ordered_cone_gpt
candidate_structures.description: Abstract finite ordered-cone representation whose admissible states need not be a simplex and need not come from any star-algebra.

preorder_definition: For this finite fixture, A <= B iff (1) A and B reproduce the same quotient class partition, (2) the class-token map i -> i preserves every probe-outcome vector, and (3) strength_rank(A) <= strength_rank(B). Strict weakness is A <= B and not B <= A.

lineage.F01: affirmative: S has six elements and P has two finite probes.
lineage.N01: affirmative: U1 and U2 are explicit endofunctions on S and have a measured order-dependent composition witness.
lineage.root_axiom: a=a iff a~b -> identity is the equivalence class of a in S/~_P.
